gaps.sentence: At no time ___ the crew aware of the danger.
gaps.explanation: 'At no time was the crew aware' — inverted past simple of be.

gaps.sentence: Barely ___ the ink dried when the complaints began to arrive.
gaps.explanation: 'Barely had the ink dried when …' — inverted past perfect.

gaps.sentence: Only after the third attempt ___ she pass the test.
gaps.explanation: 'Only after' at the front forces question word order: did she pass.

gaps.sentence: Only when the results were published ___ the scale of the error become clear.
gaps.explanation: 'Only when … did the scale … become clear' — inverted past simple.

gaps.sentence: Not since the 1990s ___ unemployment been so low.
gaps.explanation: Not since X has Y happened — present perfect inversion.

gaps.sentence: Scarcely had the anthem finished ___ the crowd invaded the pitch.
So rapid ___ the spread of the fire that the building was lost.
gaps.explanation: 'So rapid was the spread that …' — fronted 'so + adj' with inversion.

gaps.sentence: Try ___ she might, she couldn't restart the engine.
gaps.explanation: 'Try as somebody might' — fixed concessive inversion.
